_about: Contract history for measuring opportunity security (docs/PLAN-contract-history.md). STUDY DATA ONLY: nothing on the site reads this file; the site reads data/delta-contracts.json. Built from original news reports found through outside research and checked by hand; never copied from OverTheCap or Spotrac. Keyed by nflverse player ID. Money is in $ millions. `signed` is the date the deal or option decision was made or first reported, so each snapshot can use only what was known then: take the latest contract signed before the season, and honour `released`. `total` and `aav` cover the new years only, except where `money_covers` says otherwise. `guaranteed_at_signing` is what was fully guaranteed that day and can include money from older years on the deal, so never divide it by `total`. On a fifth-year option it is the full amount for the 2018 draft class onward (the 2020 labour deal) and null before that (guaranteed for injury only until the option season's league year). `option`: exercised, declined, or extended (a new deal replaced the decision).
contract_rule: Owner, 25 Oct 2026: `end` is the last playable season written into the contract, even when the team can decline, cut or void later years. Never counted: void years (salary-cap placeholders that can never be played) and a first-rounder's fifth-year option until the team picks it up (that year is not in the rookie deal until then). Owner exception: a player who has left his team and stopped reporting (no longer with the team, though it holds his rights) counts as no contract, kind `left_team` (Brandon Aiyuk).
team_codes: Follow the site where the codes differ (JAC, LAR), and keep the club name of the day otherwise (OAK).
